_comment: Source of truth for main branch protection. Apply with: gh api repos/Smith-Horn/skillsmith/branches/main/protection -X PUT --input .github/branch-protection.json UPDATED 2026-10-03: this file had drifted TWO contexts behind live protection, and the drift direction matters -- `--fix` applies THIS FILE to GitHub, so running it would have REMOVED a required check rather than added one. `pointer-check` (the docs/internal gitlink ancestry gate, ADR-143) was added to live protection and never recorded here; `Edge Functions Typecheck` (SMI-6897) is added by the same commit that recorded it live. Both are now listed. The validator is not wired into CI, so nothing was failing -- which is exactly why the drift survived.
